title: C.W. Taekwondo

services.name: CW Taekwondo
services.desc: The CW Taekwondo Program provides an overview of all aspects of modern World Taekwondo, from the traditional art of poomsae (forms) and self-defense to the modern Olympic sport. Considerable emphasis is also placed on muscle stretching, strengthening and cardiovascular fitness using safe, effective techniques. Whether this is your first step to black belt or simply a fun way to get some exercise, you will find this program challenging and fun. Come to the club before class to sign up. You can start the program at any time you want. No test fees or other hidden fees. No contracts that lock you in. Try a free trial on us! Find a date that works for you and meet our instructor on the day of!
